description: Script for managing review lifecycle dates (start, stop, clear) for components in a software project, manipulating metadata.yaml files and generating reports.

methods.name: list_components
methods.description: Lists all components by locating metadata.yaml files and processing their paths.

methods.name: show_help
methods.description: Displays usage instructions and lists available components.

methods.name: resolve_metadata
methods.description: Resolves the path to a component's metadata.yaml file, providing an error message if not found.

methods.name: add_business_days
methods.description: Adds a specified number of business days to a given date.

methods.name: clear_dates
methods.description: Clears lifecycle date fields in the metadata.yaml file.

methods.name: regen_report
methods.description: Regenerates the RAG status report by calling an external script.
